description: Searches Grants.gov for open or forecasted federal grant opportunities by keyword, eligibility, agency, category, posting date and closing date. Returns up to 30 rows per page, per-item errors, and XLSX pipeline-tracker and ICS deadline downloads. Covers federal opportunities on Grants.gov only; private foundation, state and local grants are out of scope.

closing_after.description: Inclusive earliest closing date, e.g. 2026-10-21; the default is today in America/New_York.

closing_before.description: Inclusive latest closing date, e.g. 2026-12-20; at most 730 days after today.

eligibility.description: Applicant types, e.g. ["nonprofit_501c3"]; unrestricted notices are included.

include_no_close_date.description: true includes rolling or undated notices. Default true.

instruments.description: Funding instruments, e.g. ["G"] for grants or ["CA"] for cooperative agreements.

keyword.description: Words to search for, e.g. youth mentoring; quotes are removed.

match_all_words.description: true matches only notices containing every keyword word; false matches any word. Default false.

max_results.description: Rows per page, e.g. 25; from 1 to 30.

page.description: Page number after screening and sorting, e.g. 1; from 1 to 20.

posted_within_days.description: Number of days since posting, e.g. 7 for a weekly scan.

statuses.description: Notice status, e.g. ["posted"]; the default includes posted and forecasted notices.

name: find_grant_opportunities
title: Find federal grant opportunities
